# 3:17 (Back2SleepNow.com)

> 3:17 is a pre-launch brand making a middle of the night sleep shot for women in menopause who wake in the night. The site has a waitlist for the first batch and a blog of sourced, plain-language articles about night waking in menopause, written by founder Marian Grout. Articles are educational, not medical advice.

## Pages

- [Home and waitlist](https://back2sleepnow.com/): the middle of the night sleep shot, made for women in menopause.
- [Blog](https://back2sleepnow.com/blog): all articles.
- [About Marian Grout](https://back2sleepnow.com/about): founder of 3:17.

## Articles

- [Awake at 3 a.m. and can't get back to sleep? What to do in menopause](https://back2sleepnow.com/blog/cant-get-back-to-sleep-menopause): Can't get back to sleep in menopause? Read what NHS guidance and CBT-I research say about night waking, practical next steps, and when to speak with your GP.
- [Night Sweats Waking Me Up Every Night: What Are My Options?](https://back2sleepnow.com/blog/night-sweats-waking-me-up-every-night-options): Night sweats waking you up? A balanced look at bedroom changes, diaries, hormone therapy, non-hormonal options and CBT, and how to decide with your clinician.
- [Why do I wake at 3 a.m. in menopause?](https://back2sleepnow.com/blog/why-wake-3am-menopause): Waking at 3 a.m. in menopause? Read what research says about night waking and hot flushes, where the evidence stops, and when to speak with your clinician.
